newsitem.title: USA: Smart & Final program to affect margins.
newsitem.headline: Smart & Final program to affect margins.

text.p: Smart & Final Inc Tuesday said its "New Sliced Prices" program of lowering prices on key store items is expected to affect gross margins for the remainder of the year, although at a lesser rate than they did in the just-completed first quarter.

In a statement, the company said reduced margins and accompanying extensive marketing reduced earnings for the quarter by $0.02 per share in the first quarter. However the company said the program produced increased sales with same store sales growing at a 4.4 percent rate in the last month of the quarter.

As reorted, Smart & Final reported a profit of $0.22 a share in the first quarter of 1997 versus $0.20 in the first quarter of the prior year. Common shares outstanding increased by 1,754,000 shares over the prior year quarter, primarily due to new shares issued in connection with the acquisition of stores from an affiliated company late in 1996. The company said the transaction added approximately one half of one cent per share in earnings for the quarter.
